final.letter:
Guidance on your pending land case in Lucknow
09 October 2026

Aapke father ka land case jo Lucknow Civil Court mein 6 saal se pending hai, uske liye aap eCourts website ya 'eCourts Services' mobile app ka use kar sakte hain. Wahan aap apne case ka 16-character CNR number daal kar latest status, next hearing date, aur court orders check kar sakte hain. Agar aapke paas CNR number nahi hai, toh aap court, case type, case number, aur year ka use karke bhi search kar sakte hain. Kyunki aap child hain, aap free legal aid ke liye eligible ho sakte hain. Aap apne district ki District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) se contact karein. Aap unki helpline number 15100 par call karke free legal advice aur lawyer ke baare mein pooch sakte hain. Iske alawa, aap Lok Adalat ya mediation ka option bhi explore kar sakte hain, jahan cases jaldi settle ho sakte hain. Apne case se jude saare documents, jaise ki purane orders aur notices, hamesha ready rakhein taaki jab aap DLSA ya kisi naye lawyer se baat karein, toh unhe puri jankari mil sake.

This is general information to help you take the next step. It is not legal advice; a lawyer or the District Legal Services Authority can advise on your situation.

## Where to get help
1. **District Legal Services Authority (DLSA)** (DLSA office at your district court · NALSA legal-aid helpline) — First. Free legal advice, and a free lawyer if you are eligible; DLSA also runs Lok Adalats for settling disputes without a trial. https://nalsa.gov.in · 15100
2. **eCourts case status** (eCourts Services website / app) — If you already have a case: check its status, next hearing date and orders with the 16-character CNR number, or with the court, case type, number and year. https://services.ecourts.gov.in

_Information, not legal advice._
